dog.description_text:
💕 12 Weeks Old | Female | Doxie Mix | 7.2 Pounds 💕
Looking for a sweet, laid-back little girl who loves cuddles just as much as playtime? Nova might be your perfect match! ❤️
🐶 Nova is a gentle, easygoing puppy who absolutely LOVES her naps! Give her a soft, fuzzy bed, and she's one happy little girl!
💕 But don't let her relaxed personality fool you! When she's done snoozing, she's ready to chase her sister and enjoy some puppy playtime!
🏡 This smart little girl is already learning her puppy manners! She sleeps well through the night, goes potty when taken outside, and has recently learned how to use the doggie door! What a clever girl!
🦴 And did someone say SNACKS?! 😂 Nova LOVES her treats, and trust us, she'll let you know when she's ready for one!
dog.name: Nova
